notes.text: The target entry is Evyatar. Gittin gives both named interpretations of the concubine in Gibeah and presents both in the dialogue with Elijah.

Letter Pe section 10 assigns both sages to the mystical repair of the father of the concubine. It separately assigns Chanina ben Gamliel to the man of the concubine. Preserve the source as mystical interpretation and the short entry’s pointer as written.
The exact digital text differentiates the father from the man of the concubine. Heilprin’s reciprocal abbreviated wording should be collated before clarifying the referent in the translation.
